rows.title: Planet Earth Is Blue and Far Away in Duncan Jones’s Film
rows.dek_lead: “Moon,” Duncan Jones’s modest, haunting first feature, offers something of an antidote, presenting a vision of life beyond Earth that emphasizes claustrophobia and loneliness.
